req.title: Retrieve task by id
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /tasks/{task_id}. I design tests using EP (valid id returns 200 with correct body), NEG (non-existent id returns 404, non-integer id returns 422), and BVA (boundary ids: id=1 lowest seeded, id=20 highest seeded, id=0 below minimum valid integer, id=21 just above seeded range). Each test uses an in-process SQLite DB seeded with the 20 pre-loaded rows, asserts exact status codes and exact field values to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations. Boolean fields (completed true/false), nullable fields (description null, updated_at null), and exact string fields are all asserted to catch field-swap and value mutations.

tests.name: test_get_task_by_id_positive_completed_true
preconditions: Task id=1 exists with title='Read chapter 5', completed=true
expected: Response body contains id=1, title='Read chapter 5', completed=true
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
db_path = os.path.join(tmp, 'test_pos1.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{db_path}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

with TestingSession() as db:
    db.add(models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', description='Signal pulse ember orbit harbor', completed=True))
    db.commit()

def test_get_task_by_id_positive_completed_true():
    r = client.get('/tasks/1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 1
    assert body['title'] == 'Read chapter 5'
    assert body['completed'] is True
    assert 'created_at' in body

test_get_task_by_id_positive_completed_true()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
